title: Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars

match.zip: Broken Sword - The Shadow of the Templars.zip

widgets.text: George Stobbart, an American tourist, investigates a café bombing in Paris that leads to the Knights Templar.

rows: The assassin in the clown suit

widgets.text: Stuck? Talk to everyone about every item and topic (use items on people too). Re-examine hotspots after new events. Most puzzles in a location use only items found nearby or the last thing you picked up.
Paris (café, Nico's flat, hospital, Hotel Ubu), Ireland (Lochmarne), Syria (Marib), Spain (the Villa), Scotland (Bull's Head finale).
Key clues: the clown's newspaper, the Templar manuscript, the tripod and the chess piece. Keep every document: later puzzles refer back to them.
Paris -> Ireland -> Paris -> Syria -> Paris -> Spain -> Paris -> Scotland.
